intent: Implement the approved GPU/NPU runtime, graph preparation, SDK streaming, memory reuse, thermal scheduling, diagnostic export and qualification improvements; preserve concurrent changes and all existing verification gates; finish with verified publication after current PR and actual-main checks pass.
authorization: The user explicitly resumed implementation, draft push, green-gated merge and publication after the earlier Stop. This task is active and must be reconciled before publishing the shared release.
acceptance: A compatible runtime upgrade includes actual published artifact verification and matching shared-QAIRT dispatch provenance; an older binary must never be relabelled as a new SDK build.

A reproducible source-build and model diagnostic path uses original floating weights, explicit backend variants and representative calibration; physical correctness and performance remain measured claims only.
Native compiled contexts have bounded atomic persistence, immutable model/runtime/device/shape/options identities, digest checks, conservative invalidation and safe source-model fallback.
Native evidence distinguishes engine load, graph compilation, saved-context loading, resident reuse and inference; old receipts remain readable without invented observations.
GPU divergence diagnostics retain CPU-reference comparisons and shape/precision safeguards; invalid audio never qualifies for production acceleration.
LiteRT Kokoro bucket settings are wired from settings and benchmarks through factory/cache identity to the real SDK without truncating text.
Incremental SDK reply streams retain stable text, bounded PCM/backpressure, caption offsets, interruption and actual native retirement; native and Gateway paths retain their contracts.
Supported per-utterance voice changes reuse model weights without silently changing the requested voice, language or quality preference.
Voice uses the existing thermal governor and supported performance hints without competing thermal polling or changing spoken content.

Speech/performance exports are staged to private files off the UI thread, recover after picker failures and process recreation using small identifiers, stream bounded records and preserve final content.
Benchmarks expose the new experiment identities and preparation sources, preserve cross-engine/processor evidence distinctions, and support defined sustained qualification.

Run meaningful regressions and unchanged canonical gates, reconcile each incoming branch advance, push a guarded append, merge normally only with current required checks, then verify actual-main and signed Android/Gateway publication.
